title: Retrieving from Your Own Mistakes: On-Policy Training of Embedding Models for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
abstract: arXiv:2610.40409v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Complex questions in retrieval-augmented generation require evidence spread over several documents, and an answer is reliable only when the retriever finds all of it. Chain embedding retrievers collect such evidence step by step, re-encoding the question together with the passages retrieved so far, and we find that they are already strong: trained only on gold histories, a small chain embedding retriever that calls no language model outperforms graph-based systems and is competitive with a search agent. This training, however, leaves a gap. At test time the retriever conditions on its own retrievals, which soon contain mistakes: by the third step, about half or more of the states it visits hold a wrong passage, and these passages lower its chance of retrieving a missing gold passage well beyond what the difficulty of the states explains. We propose on-policy state training, which trains the encoder on the states it reaches itself. At eve

translated_title: 从自身错误中检索：面向多跳检索增强生成的嵌入模型在线策略训练
translated_abstract: 检索增强生成中的复杂问题需要分布于多个文档的证据，只有当检索器找齐全部证据时，答案才可靠。链式嵌入检索器逐步收集此类证据，将问题与已检索到的段落一起重新编码后继续检索；我们发现它们已经相当强大：仅用金标历史训练、不调用任何语言模型的小型链式嵌入检索器，性能超越基于图的系统，并可与搜索代理媲美。然而，这种训练方式存在缺口：测试时检索器以自身的检索结果为条件，而这些结果很快就会出现错误——到第三步时，它所访问的状态中约有一半及以上包含错误段落，这些段落对其检索出缺失金标段落的负面影响远超状态自身难度所能解释的程度。为此，我们提出在线策略状态训练，即在编码器自身到达的状态上对其进行训练……
tldr: 该论文提出在线策略状态训练方法，让链式嵌入检索器直接在自身检索（包含错误段落）所得到的状态上进行训练，从而弥合金标历史训练与测试时自检索错误之间的差距，提升多跳检索增强生成的检索鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes on-policy state training, which trains chain embedding retrievers on the error-containing states they themselves reach during retrieval, closing the gap between training on gold histories and test-time self-conditioning to make multi-hop retrieval-augmented generation more robust.
